title: XGBoost interaction_constraints — capability + causal-ablation on the D6 cell (nifty50 H=25)
n_caveat: n=1 — one cell (nifty50 up/+10%/25d/dd5%). Single forbidden pair. Verdict is the user's to read.

headline_answer.how: interaction_constraints flows through the construction/spec path (XGBoostModel ctor -> _validate_hp_xgb -> xgb.XGBClassifier(**hp) -> booster) untouched, because _validate_hp_xgb only range/enum-checks KNOWN HP keys; an unknown structured key passes through. The sanctioned surface is gbdt.interactions.ablate_interactions, which injects it post-construction. Verified the booster receives it (save_config shows interaction_constraints stored) and honors it.
headline_answer.what_blocks_the_loop_path: The agent-loop decision path (loop_protocol.validate_decision) REJECTS interaction_constraints as an 'unknown HP' — it is not in TUNABLE_HP_RANGES_XGB / ENUM_HP_VALUES_XGB / PINNED_HPS_XGB. This is BY DESIGN (V1.2 plan § 7; XGBOOST_HP_REFERENCE.md line 19): interaction_constraints is a Phase-4 read-only causal-ablation tool, never a per-iteration FS+HP knob. Exactly symmetric to monotone_constraints on CatBoost (see _174 § 'Iteration 5'). So it is NOT a per-iteration loop knob, but IS runnable via the ablation surface / spec hp_starting.
headline_answer.plumbing_added_this_branch: NONE — the capability was already present (V1.2 Phases 1-5, on main). This branch added only the two finalize specs + the verification runner + this analysis. Flagged explicitly so the reviewer knows no src/gbdt/ behavior changed.

plumbing_probe.decision_path_error: decision.hp_changes references unknown HP 'interaction_constraints'; not a tunable xgboost HP

determinism.note: Refitting the depth-8 / 279-feat config twice (tree_method=exact, n_jobs=1, device=cpu, seed=42) gives bit-identical eval predictions; the refit reproduces the on-disk model.ubj. The § 5.1 finalization-retrain contract holds.

interaction_structure.method: native TreeSHAP pred_interactions (dense reference), F=279, 200-row seeded sub-sample
interaction_structure.reading: Top interactions are long-window vol-estimator x index-regime pairs — the same 'interaction-driven cell' structure _147/_174/_149 found (vol x regime conditional).

ablation_verification.reading: The constraint TOOK EFFECT and was HONORED, not silently ignored: the forbidden pair's SHAP interaction collapsed 0.0801 -> 0.0 AND its gain-weighted tree-path co-occurrence dropped 58.94 -> exactly 0 (it never co-splits in the constrained model).

metrics_constrained_vs_unconstrained.calibration: both isotonic (fresh isotonic fit on val for each model; conditional-isotonic Z-test rejects native on this cell)
metrics_constrained_vs_unconstrained.reading: Forbidding the TOP SHAP-interaction pair did NOT degrade metrics — it slightly IMPROVED Brier (eval -0.0005, test -0.0053) and left R-precision ~flat (eval +0.005, test -0.002). The SHAP->causal-contribution link is real (the pair's interaction collapsed to 0), but on THIS cell the top interaction was not net-positive for predictability: forbidding it acted as mild regularization. Consistent with _147/_174/_149's no-overfit, FS/constraints-neutral-to-harmful regime — heavy regularization HURTS here, but forbidding ONE redundant vol-vol co-split is benign-to-helpful. A genuinely load-bearing interaction would have degraded; this one was redundant (index_vol_50 and index_vol_200 are correlated lookbacks of the same index-vol signal).

catboost_contrast.reading: CatBoost MEASURES the same vol x index-regime interaction family but exposes NO interaction_constraints knob — confirming the V1.2 rationale: the constrained-vs-unconstrained ablation above is impossible on CatBoost. That contrast is the point of moving to XGBoost.

user_facing_verdict: NO automated PASS/FAIL. The capability question is answered YES (runnable today via the ablation/spec path; blocked from the loop schema by design). The ablation confirms the SHAP->causal mechanism (forbidden pair's interaction verifiably collapses). On this n=1 cell the top interaction was redundant, so forbidding it was neutral-to-mildly-beneficial — itself an informative finding about the cell's regularization regime, NOT evidence the tooling is wrong.
